items.title: Corporate Events
items.description: From intimate boardroom dinners to large-scale product launches and international conferences, we manage every aspect of your corporate event with professionalism and flair.

items.title: Private Celebrations
items.description: Life's milestone moments deserve to be celebrated with intention. We design celebrations that feel entirely, unmistakably yours.

items.title: Venue Sourcing
items.description: We know London's finest venues intimately — from historic palaces and private members' clubs to contemporary rooftop spaces and hidden gems not listed online.

items.title: Chauffeur & Transfers
items.description: First impressions begin at the airport. Our premium transfer service ensures every guest arrives in comfort and style, whether for a small delegation or a full conference.

items.description: For international delegations, incentive groups, and corporate travel programmes, our full DMC package covers every touchpoint of your London visit — from arrival to departure.

story.title: Born from a Belief That Events Should Be Extraordinary
story.p1: Elara London Events was founded in 2012 by a team of hospitality and event professionals with one shared conviction: that truly exceptional events don't just happen — they are carefully, lovingly crafted.
story.p2: Over more than a decade, we have grown into one of London's most trusted luxury event partners, serving clients from over 30 countries across corporate, private, and international travel sectors.
story.p3: Our name, Elara, is drawn from the moons of Jupiter — a nod to our ambition to reach further, illuminate more, and bring a celestial quality to every occasion we create.

items.title: Excellence Without Compromise
items.description: We hold every detail to the highest standard — from the placement of a centrepiece to the timing of a keynote. Good enough is never good enough for us.

items.title: Absolute Discretion
items.description: Our clients trust us with their most significant moments. We honour that trust with complete confidentiality, professionalism, and care at every stage.

items.title: Deep Local Knowledge
items.description: London is our home. We know its venues, its rhythms, its suppliers, and its secrets — and we use that knowledge to create experiences that no outsider could replicate.
